hindsight_policy: World data for the FIBA pipeline. Holds format, calendar and (where listed) real entry lists and squads only. No score, result, standing, award or statistic of this event is recorded. Real qualification routes and real group draws describe the real world; a simulated career must derive the field of any edition whose qualifiers it simulates from simulated results, and must not read this file before the dates given in known_from.

known_from.note: The entry list depends on results of the 2007 continental championships; the knockout pairings depend on results of this event.

rule.value: The two semifinal winners qualify (no final is played); the semifinal losers play for the third berth.

reason.value: The United States had qualified for the 2008 Olympics outright as 2007 FIBA Americas champion.

usa_participation.note: In a simulated career the USA would enter only by finishing 3rd-5th at a simulated 2007 FIBA Americas Championship (the Americas allocation is 3 teams).

time_zone.source: Greece observes EEST in July; the source gives local times without naming the zone

rounds.advance: top 2 of each group to the quarterfinals; the 3rd-placed team is eliminated

rounds.note: semifinal winners qualify for the Olympics
winner takes the third Olympic berth; no final is played

classification.value: Places 1-2: semifinal winners (no final); 3-4 from the third-place game; 5-8 quarterfinal losers and 9-12 group 3rd placers, ranked by record (exact ranking criteria not stated).
